subject: Drawing Straight Line Radials on Polar Plot

messages.author: 17edf26f144e6b15
messages.subject: Drawing Straight Line Radials on Polar Plot
parts:
I am trying to plot a series of variable length radial lines
overlaying a simple windrose. The windrose portion works fine but I'm
having real difficulties drawing a straight radial. I have tried
several solutions but none appear to work.

df is the dataframe contains four numeric variables: $x, $y, $g,
$gmean

ggplot() +
geom_bar(aes(y = gmean,x = as.factor(x),fill =
as.factor(g)),data=df,width = 1.0) +
geom_linerange(aes(x = x[1],ymin=0,ymax=gmean[1])) +
coord_polar()

gives the "error inherits (x, "factor"): object 'r' not found"

ggplot() +
geom_bar(aes(y = gmean,x = as.factor(x),fill =
as.factor(g)),data=df,width = 1.0) +
geom_line(aes(x=c(0,x[1]),y=c(0,gmean[1])), data=df) +
coord_polar()

which plots curved rather than straight radial. I tried using polar
coordinates but no real difference

ggplot() +
geom_bar(aes(y = gmean,x = as.factor(x),fill =
as.factor(g)),data=df,width = 1.0) +
geom_segment(aes(x = 0, xend=x[1],y=0,yend=gmean[1])) +
coord_polar()

with similar results

I'm obviously missing something very simple. Any thoughts would be
very much appreciated.

Regards

Richard
